column3: ## Checkbox state is not saved with the application

Go to the application form and complete and submit an application with Mexico or Indonesia as "Publisher's country", ticking the pre-assessment checklist checkbox when prompted

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply

column4: The application submits successfully and you are shown the confirmation page

column3: As an admin, open the submitted application (or inspect the Application record in Elasticsearch)

column4: There is no field anywhere in the application relating to the pre-assessment checklist checkbox. This is expected - the checkbox is UI-only and is not stored.

column3: Note: the checkbox requirement is enforced in the browser only. Submitting via the API, or bypassing the JavaScript validation, is not blocked by it. This is a known and accepted limitation, not a bug.
